status: Two RGB-only hand-estimation pilots completed; not accepted as exact 3D ground truth or production retargeting
request: Re-estimate hand poses from RGB after observing EgoDex reprojection mismatch
base_environment: Read-only inherited dexverse-stack Python 3.11 / torch 2.7 cu128; extra dependencies installed only in rgb-env

models.wilor: CVPR 2025 WiLoR, via WiLoR-mini simplified demo inference package linked by official repository
models.mediapipe: 0.10.21 Hands, static-image mode, model complexity 1, max 2 hands, minimum detection confidence 0.5

protocol.inputs: Original 1920x1080 RGB frames only; no EgoDex pose/box/hand identity supplied to either estimator
protocol.camera: Unmodified default virtual focal length; not metric-calibrated world-frame 3D
protocol.v1: Unmodified detector produced duplicate opposite-handedness boxes: 8 chopsticks frames and 1 bottle frame had 3 detections
protocol.v2: Detector max_det=2, agnostic_nms=true, iou=0.45, conf=0.3 for known single-wearer videos; no pose smoothing
protocol.v2_identity_audit: Every sampled frame in both clips has one label 0 and one label 1. This is not proof of pose accuracy

outputs.prediction_contents: Per-frame native RGB 2D keypoints, wrist-relative MANO 3D joints/vertices, inferred camera translation, MANO pose/shape, detector boxes and handedness, independent MediaPipe landmarks, EgoDex 2D comparison only

judgment.chopsticks: WiLoR visually aligns visible fingertips and finger flexion better than the original EgoDex projection in inspected start/middle/end frames. MediaPipe frequently misses the active right hand
judgment.bottle: Mixed improvement; occluded digits remain ambiguous or misaligned. MediaPipe sometimes looks better locally; no automatic ensemble selected
judgment.metric_accuracy: Not measured: no independently annotated visible-keypoint ground truth or calibrated 3D ground truth
judgment.speed: WiLoR detector plus reconstruction median approximately 0.17 seconds per 1080p frame on Remi RTX4090, excluding model loading, video decode and output encoding
judgment.production: Do not replace existing retargeter inputs or scale to full EgoDex yet

verification.visual: Inspected start/middle/end RGB skeleton overlays and enlarged right-hand views in both clips
verification.numerical: Recorded detection counts and exact upstream revisions in per-clip summary.json
verification.scope: No robot overlay, contact simulation, manual pose correction, model training, old-output overwrite, commit or push

limitations: Monocular absolute depth and scale are ambiguous
Hidden fingertips may be plausible predictions rather than observed contacts
No temporal identity association or demonstrated jitter reduction
WiLoR-mini is a demo-only simplified wrapper, not a full original-paper reproduction
WiLoR, MANO, Ultralytics and EgoDex have distinct licenses; artifacts and model files remain private local research outputs, not cleared for redistribution
next: Validate visible RGB landmarks and temporal consistency first; only then adapt chosen estimates to robot retargeting with explicit scale/depth calibration. Do not use EgoDex fit error as RGB alignment accuracy.
